event.title: New Wild Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia, First in Over a Century
event.canonical_title: New Wild Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia, First in Over a Century
event.summary: A new species of wild cat has been identified in Bolivia's cloud forest, marking the first formal naming of a living cat species in over a century. This diminutive feline, known locally as tilcayo, is part of the tiger cat group found throughout South America. The discovery highlights the rich biodiversity of Bolivia's Yungas forest.

timeline.title: New Wild Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia, First in Over a Century
timeline.summary: A new species of wild cat has been identified in Bolivia, marking the first new cat species named in over a century. The small, spotted feline had been living at a wildlife sanctuary after being rescued by a local family, where it remained unnoticed until its recent classification.

revisions.title: New Wild Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia, First in Over a Century
revisions.summary: A previously unknown species of wild cat has been identified at a wildlife sanctuary in Bolivia. This small, spotted feline had been living at the sanctuary for years before genetic analysis confirmed it as the first new wild cat species recognized in over a century.
